title: 'adapter: Cline'

**Cline** is not supported yet. This is a self-contained first contribution: the scaffold
writes the code, the fixtures and the registration, and what is left is the part below.

Read [`docs/writing-an-adapter.md`](../../docs/writing-an-adapter.md) first — it is the
whole workflow, and it is written for someone who has never seen this codebase.

## What Cline reads

- `.clinerules/` at the project root — every `.md` and `.txt` file in it, combined.
- Global rules: `~/Documents/Cline/Rules` (`Documents\Cline\Rules` on Windows).
- Cross-tool files it also reads: `.cursorrules`, `.windsurfrules`, and `AGENTS.md`.

Workspace rules take precedence over global ones when they conflict.

**Documentation:** Cline — Rules — https://docs.cline.bot/features/cline-rules
_(read 2026-09-04; re-read it before you file the precedence data, and put the date you
actually read it in `retrieved`.)_

**MCP is out of scope for this adapter.** Cline documents no project-level MCP config file:
servers live in user-level storage outside any repository, and Rulegate never writes there.
The adapter emits no MCP artifact and records the global rules path as unmanaged instead.

## What to build

- **Adapter id:** `cline`
- **Artifact to generate:** `.clinerules/<slug>.md`, one file per rule
- **Rendering:** one Markdown file per rule in `.clinerules/`
- **Resolution:** `additive` — all files in the directory are combined

## The part that needs care

Cline reads `.cursorrules`, `.windsurfrules` **and** `AGENTS.md` on top of its own
directory. That means enabling `cline` alongside `codex` sends Cline the same rules twice —
exactly the situation `rulegate doctor`'s duplicate-load warning exists for. Record those
files in `docs.files` with `managed: false` so the warning fires on its own; do not write
them from this adapter.

## Steps

```bash
rulegate adapter new cline          # prints the plan
rulegate adapter new cline --yes    # applies it
pnpm install && pnpm test           # green as generated
```

1. Hand-write `fixtures/cline/expected/` from the documentation above, **before** touching
   `write()`. A golden generated by the adapter it checks proves only that the adapter
   agrees with itself.
2. Implement `detect` → `read` → `write` until the golden passes byte-exact.
3. Fill in `packages/adapters/cline/src/docs.ts` — every placeholder there is `TODO`, and
   dated `1970-01-01` so an unverified claim cannot be mistaken for a verified one.
4. Run Cline against the generated config and confirm it actually loads. Say so in the PR,
   with the version you tested.
5. Add `cline` to `.rulegate/rulegate.yaml` and run `rulegate sync` — this repository
   dogfoods every adapter it ships. Commit the generated file with your change.

## Done when

- `pnpm verify` is clean and `fixtures/cline/expected/` was written by hand, from the docs
- `detect` fixtures: `positive/` detected, `negative/` not
- `src/docs.ts` carries a real source URL, a real `retrieved` date, and the Cline version
  you verified against
- You ran the real tool and it loaded the file

Ask anything in the comments — an unanswerable question here is a bug in this issue.
